messages:
lin: Heads up — deploybot alerted on canary latency +20% at 04:02 UTC for model rw-infer/transformer-3 v3.6.0-canary. Deploy-bot suggested auto-rollback but auto was throttled.
rachel: what's the scope? canary percentage and regions?
lin: 8% traffic, us-west + eu-central. No error rate change, just p95 jump around decode tokens 8-18.
tom: any infra churn? kernel flags changed in this build?
lin: yes, build includes new attention kernel selection + small kv cache layout tweak.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: AUTO-ROLLBACK recommendation: flag-change rollback preferred. Conditions: error_rate<2%, latency_delta=+20% -> require human decision. Runbook: POST /api/changes/rollback {"scope":"canary","type":"flag","flag":"kernel_selection_v2"}
eng-manager: Given low error rate, prefer toggling kernel flag back rather than full version pin. Lower blast radius and faster revert test.
rachel: +1 to flag toggle. If toggle doesn't bring p95 down in 10m, we escalate to version pin to v3.5.3.
lin: can ops do a staged flag toggle? 25% -> 50% -> 0 over 5m steps?
deploy-bot: Deploybot: STAGED_FLAG_TOGGLE workflow available. CLI: 
```
rb deploy flag-toggle --model rw-infer/transformer-3 --flag kernel_selection_v2 --scope canary --stages 25,50,100 --wait 300
```
Estimated apply time per stage ~60s.
tom: I'll run the toggle. Ops please stand by to pin if needed.
security: tagging — any customer data or KMS impact? looks safe but confirm logs.
rachel: no KMS impact. Just infer runtime kernel selector.
lin: starting stage 25 now.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG stage applied: 25% (kernel_selection_v2=false). Change id: change-1766001234-flag-01.
lin: quick smoke (10 requests) -> p95 reduced ~8%. Good sign. Moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG stage applied: 50%.
tom: monitoring dashboards — p95 trending down but noisy. kv_cache_hitrate unchanged.
lin: moving to 100% stage.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG stage applied: 100%. All canary traffic now using previous kernel.
rachel: running extended smoke (50 calls) — p95 back within 2% of baseline.
eng-manager: Nice. No pin required. Create follow-up investigation ticket to root cause kernel selector heuristics and add unit test for cache alignment.
lin: opening ticket RW-1501. Assigning to runtime team.
security: confirm we should not proactively notify customers?
eng-manager: keep customers informed only if they raised issues. Draft a one-liner internal release note: "Mitigated canary latency regression by toggling kernel_selection_v2 flag; follow-up RW-1501 opened."
tom: please update release notes and add rollback steps for dedicated pools (we may need same toggle there).
lin: will add to runbook and attach the exact CLI commands.
rachel: thanks team — great fast decision. Closing thread after RW-1501 is created and docs updated. :white_check_mark:
